clue.text: Spiritual virtue nearly developed in battle of wits

explanation.definitionFit: Trivial Pursuit is a board game of general-knowledge questions, a contest of brains rather than brawn.

clue.text: Finish off European flag

clue.text: Posh officer married teacher in need of a groom

clue.text: Possibly 'sheer' ought to render this?

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

clue.text: Cryptically, this suggests I haven't a ruler

explanation.walkthrough: A reverse clue: the answer itself is the wordplay. Read 'terrible' as an anagram signal and the two words before it scramble I HAVEN'T.
explanation.definitionFit: Ivan IV, the first Tsar of all Russia, is known in English as Ivan the Terrible.

clue.text: After a time, Job's no fan of God

clue.text: Out to lunch, I chat men up stress-free

clue.text: Herald of king captured by enemy on trail

clue.text: Republican saving the planet, really getting better

parts.note: eco- describes environmental, planet-friendly things

clue.text: Maybe Victorian PM comes from Caernarvonshire
